title: Extract From Intelligence Report Of December

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. P. REGISTRY
D. D. 2045
21. 12. 31.

Extract from Intelligence Report of
DECEMBER 19, 1931.

CHIW

Chen Te-tseng released by Nanking Authorities

Chen Te-tseng (陳德徵), ex-editor of the Minkuopo and
a notorious agitator, who has been detained at Nanking since
September 1930 on charges of malpractices, was released on Dec.
16. Chen will be remembered best as the firebrand chief of the
Propaganda Department of the local Kuomintang. He also held the
post of Chief of the local Bureau of Education.

Key. Please let me know the date
of the above report. JMS
12007 1935
Sir,
Date given above.
22/12

1931年12月21日。

摘自
1931年12月19日的情报报告。

陈德徵

陈德徵获南京当局释放

陈德徵（陳德徵），前《民国日报》编辑及臭名昭著的煽动者，自1930年9月以来因涉嫌舞弊行为被拘留于南京，已于12月16日获释。人们印象最深的陈德徵，是当地国民党宣传部的激进首领。他还曾担任当地教育局局长一职。

Key. 请告知上述报告的日期。JMS
12007 1935
先生，
日期如上所示。
12/22

page_data.en:
Chen Te-cheng
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
& S. D. REGS.
S. B. D. 2045.
16 - 2 - 31

Following the impeachment by the seven Kuomintang Branches
in Shanghai against Chen Te-cheng on charges of corruption, the
Executive Committee of the Local Kuomintang Headquarters held
a meeting on August 6, 1930, and decided that Chen should resign
forthwith as Chief of the Propaganda Department of the local
Kuomintang Headquarters. The charges preferred against Chen
are reported to include the obtaining of "Squeeze" in connection
* Lee Lious with the censoring of cinema films, and the control of bookstores,
educational institutions, mosquito newspapers, and the indiscrimi-
nate dismissal of primary school teachers, the dismissed teachers
being replaced by men of Chen's own clique. It is stated that he
recently accepted $5,000 from the Grand Theatre in order to
cease his agitation in connexion with the showing of Harold
Lloyd's film "Welcome Danger". It is also stated that Chen has,
since the anti-Japanese Boycott Movement from which he unlawfully
derived a considerable sum of money, accumulated some $300,000.00.
Until his resignation, Chen Te-cheng was the most influential
Kuomintang official in Shanghai and had the profound confidence
of high officials both of the Kuomintang and the Government at
Nanking who conceived that Chen was the only able and active
Kuomintang disciple in Shanghai. This was the reason why he
held three important positions concurrently, viz : Chief of the
local Kuomintang Propaganda Department, Commissioner of Education
of the Shanghai Chinese Municipality and Editor-in-Chief of the
Kuomintang organ, Min Kuo Pao, the latter two offices Chen still
holds.
Chen Te-cheng's successor as Chief of the Propaganda Depart-
ment is one named Yang Ching-yuen, who is a native of Shanghai,
aged about 30. Yang was formerly a primary school teacher and
is known as a good penman. Little is known about his antecedents
but it is a fact that he did not previously assume himself the
role of an agitator.
page_data.zh:
陈德徵
上海公共租界
及 S. D. 登记处。
S. B. D. 2045.
1931年2月16日

继上海国民党七个支部以腐败罪名弹劾陈德徵之后，当地国民党总部执行委员会于1930年8月6日举行会议，决定陈德徵应立即辞去当地国民党总部宣传部部长职务。据报，针对陈德徵的指控包括：在审查电影、控制书店、教育机构、小报（mosquito newspapers）方面收取“勒索款”（Squeeze），以及随意解雇小学教师，而被解雇的教师则由陈德徵自己派系的人选接替。据说，他最近接受了大光明大戏院（Grand Theatre）提供的5,000美元，以停止就哈罗德·劳埃德（Harold Lloyd）的电影《不怕死》（Welcome Danger）的上映进行煽动活动。另据悉，陈德徵自从非法从中牟取巨款的抵制日货运动以来，已积累了约300,000.00美元。在辞职之前，陈德徵是上海最具影响力的国民党官员，并深得国民党及南京政府高层官员的深切信任，他们认为陈德徵是上海唯一能干且活跃的国民党信徒。这就是他同时身兼三个重要职位的原因，即：当地国民党宣传部部长、上海华界市政府教育专员以及国民党机关报《民国日报》总编辑，后两个职务陈德徵目前仍然担任。
接任陈德徵宣传部部长职务的是一名叫杨清源（音译）的人，他是上海人，年龄约30岁。杨以前是一名小学教师，以文笔好著称。关于他的背景知之甚少，但事实是他此前并未扮演过煽动者的角色。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Following Chen's resignation, a number of his former
subordinates in the Propaganda Department followed suit,
apparently to embarrass Yang Ching Yuen. Fortunately steps
were quickly taken by Van Tsung-pu, a member of the Executive
Committee of the local Kuomintang Headquarters, to fill the
vacancies by suitable candidates.

Although compelled to resign, Chen Te-cheng has not ceased
his efforts to regain his lost position. He sent his personal
secretary to Nanking on August 8 and three days later he himself
proceeded to Nanking to try to recover his former rights and
reputation. It is thought however that Chen's efforts in this
direction will not be successful as Van, prior to Chen's
resignation, had been to Nanking and made it his business there
to acquaint high Kuomintang officials with the corruption and
maladministration practised by Chen Te-cheng.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

陈德徵辞职后，其宣传部的一批前下属也相继辞职，显然是为了给杨清源制造难堪。幸运的是，当地国民党总部执行委员会委员范宗布（音译）迅速采取措施，由合适的人选填补了这些空缺。

虽然被迫辞职，但陈德徵并未停止努力以夺回其失去的地位。他于8月8日派遣其私人秘书前往南京，三天后他本人也前往南京，试图恢复其昔日的权力和声誉。然而，人们认为陈德徵在这方面的努力不会成功，因为在陈德徵辞职之前，范宗布已去过南京，并特意让国民党高层官员知晓陈德徵所实施的腐败和管理不善行为。
